Hi Maya —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick write-up to capture what we heard and agreed so we have alignment before we size and price: 

Summary of pain points (what you said)
- High tail latency during morning batch windows and unpredictable p99 spikes when traffic bursts (esp. model A / generative prompts).
- Need tenant isolation for PHI workloads; procurement requires control-plane separation and a VPC/on-prem option.
- Cost unpredictability on shared endpoints is blocking production rollout — team wants predictable unit economics for LLM inferencing.

Goals you outlined
- Pilot: support production traffic for a single model family (Model A) with up to ~400 concurrent in-flight requests at peak.
- Latency SLOs: p95 < 80ms, p99 target < 200ms for requests up to ~1k tokens (we documented current 95/99s from your telemetry).
- Compliance: SOC 2 reports, KMS integration, and audit logs for 12 months.
- Timeline: target go-live for initial pilot in ~4–6 weeks, procurement aiming for PO in ~6 weeks.

What Redwood will deliver next
1) A dedicated sizing recommendation (reserved GPU pool + burst plan) and a commercial sketch (committed capacity pricing + optional burst/overage).
2) Draft SLA that reflects the latency/availability targets and fallbacks (canary, auto-fallback to shared pool).
3) Security/compliance artifacts: SOC 2 overview, KMS integration notes, data retention/audit log description.

Requested items from Carelytics
- Confirm procurement contact and preferred billing entity (you mentioned procurement@carelytics.com).
- Share the model family names/weights and a short traffic profile (QPS, avg tokens, peak concurrency).
- Any internal network constraints for VPC peering or on-prem options.

Attachments: meeting notes and call recording stub (call-recording-20260515.mp3). I will follow up with a sizing worksheet and SLA draft for review.

Next steps (agreed on the call)
- I’ll send a sizing worksheet and initial SLA draft by Monday (May 18).
- Carelytics will surface the procurement contact and traffic numbers by EOD Monday so we can lock initial pool sizing.

Thanks — will set up a quick 30-min technical drop-in next week if your infra team wants to dig into KV cache and quantization options.

Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
